title: Teacher API pilot completed
detail: All 16 seeded GSM8K training questions received DeepSeek responses. Fifteen passed the strict verifier. No test questions or Granite training were used.

title: Correct answer rejected for currency formatting
detail: One solution ended with a dollar sign before 13. The strict numeric parser rejected it; this is a formatting rejection, not evidence of incorrect arithmetic. Original output retained.

title: Sandbox network failure resolved
detail: The first connectivity attempt failed to resolve the provider hostname. The authorized network-enabled retry verified both services and completed the pilot.

title: Scheduled supervision enabled
detail: A recurring check is configured every 15 minutes, with durable local state and approximately hourly active progress reports. Local checks require the computer and app to remain running.

title: Public research journal and Pages preview
detail: Preparing an append-only activity history, generated journal, and public dashboard. Publication will be verified before being reported as live.

id: supervisor-next-Implement and locally validate the bounded Granite LoRA training smoke test.
title: Granite training smoke test
detail: Implement and locally validate the bounded Granite LoRA training smoke test.

title: Public GitHub Pages preview verified
detail: The research dashboard is live. Browser verification confirmed the teacher pilot metrics, the journal links, and failure filtering. Scheduled supervision now includes append-only journal updates and public snapshot synchronization.
